scope: Piano-roll clip length and loop with a non-destructive truncation policy
environment: Kvant, pinned CI image, docker --network none, Qt offscreen platform
verified_behaviors: A 312-tick clip at 137 BPM loops every 68322 frames; in each of five loops the square note starts at k*68322+8103 and stops at k*68322+13358, identical at blocks 1/64/127/257/1000
Loop off matches the first loop, then is silent with the track stopped
Shortening to two beats keeps notes 3 and 4 (marked not sounding) and exports exactly like a two-beat clip with them deleted; lengthening restores the original export
Adds and moves outside the active length, and lengths 0 or above 16 bars, are refused with notes unchanged
Validation and rendering: notes up to 16 bars are valid; notes past the length are omitted and a crossing note is cut at the clip end
Save/Open keeps the length, the loop flag and the silent notes; the one-shot flag is written only when false and 'loop': true is refused
QML: the length box and Loop box edit the clip and Undo reverts each
limits: The loop always starts at the clip start; offscreen platform; no physical audio.
